name: gecici-email-mcp
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for gecici.email - Instant disposable temporary emails, smart OTP extraction, and verification links for AI Agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf).

tools.name: gecici_create_inbox
tools.description: Creates a new disposable temporary email inbox for receiving signups, verifications, or test emails.

prefix.description: Optional custom username prefix (e.g. 'myagent_99'). If omitted, a random address is generated.

tools.name: gecici_wait_for_otp
tools.description: Waits for an incoming verification email and directly extracts the 4-8 digit OTP code / SMS-like code.

address.description: The disposable email address to monitor (e.g. 'agent123@gecici.email').

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait in seconds (default: 30, max: 60).

tools.name: gecici_wait_for_magic_link
tools.description: Waits for an incoming email and directly extracts the account verification button URL / magic login link.

address.description: The disposable email address to monitor.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait in seconds (default: 30, max: 60).

tools.name: gecici_get_inbox_messages
tools.description: Lists all received messages in a disposable inbox, including senders, subjects, and extracted summaries.

address.description: The disposable email address to inspect.

tools.name: gecici_get_ai_summary
tools.description: Returns a token-optimized, high-signal clean text summary of the latest email for LLMs.
